title: About Nestora
content:
A little more home.

Nestora began with a simple idea: a home should feel warm, calm and truly yours, without costing a fortune. We carefully select home essentials, from handcrafted ceramics to soft linen bedding and warm lighting, using natural, durable materials and timeless design.

What we believe

Quality first: every item is checked for materials and finish.

Fair prices: modern design should not be a luxury.

Customer care: real people reply to every message within 24 hours.

Thank you for letting us be part of your home.

Nestora is a fictional coursework store. Products, illustrations and service promises demonstrate the proposed store experience; they do not represent a live trading business.

title: Shipping & returns
content:
From our store to your door.

Orders ship within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3–7 days; express delivery takes 1–3 days.

Delivery options

Pakistan standard delivery: $4.00. Express delivery: $9.00. Free standard shipping on orders of $75 or more. International shipping: $18.00.

A little peace of mind

Unused items can be returned within 30 days in original packaging. Refunds are issued within 5–7 days of receiving an approved return. Start a return through our Contact page with your order number.

This is a demonstration policy for coursework. No physical orders are fulfilled.

title: Privacy & credits
content:
Your details, handled with care.

This local coursework website stores account details, orders, delivery addresses, contact messages and newsletter consent in a MySQL database on the local computer. Please use fictional test details only.

Cookies and checkout

WooCommerce uses essential cookies to remember your shopping bag and account session. No real card details are requested or stored by the enabled dummy gateway. Cash on Delivery does not collect payment online.

Email and access

Order and account emails are logged locally for demonstration. They are not sent to external inboxes. Store administrators can view orders, messages and email logs. Contact the project owner to request deletion of test records.

Asset credits

Product illustrations and Nestora logo: original SVG artwork created for this project. Interior photograph: Unsplash, photo-1600210492486-724fe5c67fb0, bundled locally for the assignment. Playfair Display and Inter are distributed with their SIL Open Font License files. Foodu parent theme and Foodu Core are supplied by the user. WooCommerce and WooCommerce Dummy Payments are official open-source packages.

Replace this demonstration policy and contact details before any public launch.

title: Terms & conditions
content:
A thoughtful store, clear terms.

Nestora is a local coursework demonstration. Products, prices and stock illustrate an online store. Test orders are not offers for real goods and will not be fulfilled.

Orders and payments

Check your bag, address and delivery option before placing an order. Cash on Delivery records an order for offline collection in the demonstration. The official WooCommerce Dummy Payments gateway simulates success or failure; it does not charge a bank account or card.

Shipping and returns

The proposed delivery and returns terms appear on Shipping & Returns. For help, use the Contact page with your order number. Real company details, legal terms and a verified payment processor must be configured before a public launch.

title: A few useful answers
content:
Good to know before you order.

How long is delivery?

Orders are prepared within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery is 3–7 days and express is 1–3 days.

Is there free shipping?

Yes. Standard Pakistan shipping is free when the order reaches $75 after discounts.

How do returns work?

Unused items in their original packaging may be returned within 30 days. Send an enquiry with your order number to start.

Which payment methods can I test?

Cash on Delivery and the official WooCommerce Dummy Payments test gateway are enabled. No real card charges are made.

Where can I track my order?

Sign in to My Account to see your orders and their current status. An administrator can update them in WooCommerce → Orders.

Can I edit these products and pages?

Yes. Products are native WooCommerce records. Pages use native WordPress blocks. Logo, theme source, catalogue CSV and product artwork are included in the handover.
